events.title: Chamber of Deputies holds the second reading of the 2027 state budget: almost 150 amendments moving more than CZK 380bn, debate ends after midnight

Senate approves the rise in state payments into health insurance for state-insured persons (about CZK 13bn in 2027) and the anti-greenwashing bill, and calls on the government to back the EU loan to Ukraine at the summit
events.note: Planned as reserve story cz-senate (claim cz-senate-26, 30%) and cut by the morning: senat.cz refused requests and no report put the health-payments bill on the 25 Nov agenda, so it stayed reserve/dropped.
